events.detail_full_en: Due to the impact of an unauthorized entry onto the tracks between Shinagawa and Kawasaki stations, services were suspended. However, as of 08:50, the resumption of services has been implemented. Please note that some trains are experiencing delays.

events.detail_full: 東海道本線内で発生した線路内立入の影響で、東京〜籠原駅間の上り線(東京方面行)の運転を見合わせていましたが、08:50現在、運転を再開しています。なお、一部列車に遅れが出ています。 （11月6日 8時50分掲載）
events.detail_full_main: 東海道本線内で発生した線路内立入の影響で、東京〜籠原駅間の上り線(東京方面行)の運転を見合わせていましたが、08:50現在、運転を再開しています。なお、一部列車に遅れが出ています。
events.detail_full_zh: 受东海道本线线路内有人侵入事件影响，东京站至笼原站之间的上行线（开往东京方向）曾一度停运。截至08:50，该线路已恢复运行。但部分列车出现晚点。
events.detail_full_en: Due to the impact of an unauthorized entry onto the tracks on the Tokaido Main Line, a suspension of services was in effect on the upbound line (towards Tokyo) between Tokyo and Kogohara stations. As of 08:50, the resumption of services has been announced. However, some trains are currently experiencing delays.
